name: HnswStore::open

test_list.description: Opening a new table persists its dimension, embedder identity, and metric in SQLite.
Reopening the same table and explicit global or session scope recovers its rows and index.
A table cannot be reopened with a different dimension, embedder, or metric.
A handle is permanently bounded to its configured global or session partition.
Empty or unsafe table identities and zero or oversized dimensions fail before storage mutation.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Directory containing the authoritative SQLite database and recoverable HNSW cache files.

inputs.name: table
inputs.description: Validated table identity, dimension, embedder, and metric.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Fixed global or session partition bound to the returned handle.

output_description: A durable table handle that cannot cross its configured table or session scope.
